scope: Local same-source experiment; final CLI hardening is additionally covered by focused tests and awaits PR CI

initial_compile.note: Local compilation baseline after lint; no cook restore, not a fresh GitHub runner or linker-only CPU measurement.

cargo_execution.note: Execution after successful no-run compile in the same target. Includes any Cargo startup/revalidation; inspect log for no rebuild. Not GitHub timing or complete daemon CPU.

nextest_and_docs.execution: local_gate.rust_tests --workspace (pinned checksummed musl nextest plus Cargo doctests)
nextest_and_docs.rust_workspace: Same compiled source tree as the Cargo baseline
nextest_and_docs.conditions: same existing compiled Rust tree as baseline; tool archive warm; local Soldr0.9.34; four global tests; not a CI gain claim

link_diagnostic.conditions: Local diagnostic rebuild caused by changing linker identity; same original cc, wrapper disabled; not a before/after compiler-setting experiment.

limitations: One baseline and one candidate including doctests; not representative CI traffic.
Tool archive warm; fresh hosted installation transfer remains to measure.
Local Soldr version differs from CI; CPU/hardware and scope are not interchangeable.
Link diagnostic changes linker identity and forces a rebuild; not a speed-setting A/B comparison.
